product.title: Lake Tahoe Emerald Bay Scenic Cruise

description.text: Board a classic paddlewheeler for a scenic cruise around Lake Tahoe's Emerald Bay. An included audio guide shares how the bay formed, stories of Fannette Island, and views of Vikingsholm Castle while you choose open-air decks or climate-controlled seating.

highlights: Scenic paddlewheel cruise to Emerald Bay
Included audio guide on Fannette Island and Vikingsholm Castle
Open-air decks and indoor climate-controlled seating
Complimentary shuttle service from select South Shore hotels
Onboard restrooms and optional food and bar service

start.description: Meet at Zephyr Cove Marina, 760 US-50, Zephyr Cove, NV 89448. Arrive 30 minutes before departure to check in at the boat dock.

end.description: Return to Zephyr Cove Marina after the cruise.

product.itinerarySummary: Board a classic paddlewheeler for a scenic cruise around Lake Tahoe's Emerald Bay.

itineraryItems.title: Lake Tahoe Cruises / MS Dixie II
itineraryItems.description: Board the MS Dixie II paddlewheeler at Zephyr Cove Marina for the Emerald Bay sightseeing route.

itineraryItems.title: Fannette Island
itineraryItems.description: Pass by Fannette Island while the audio guide shares Tahoe history and Emerald Bay geology.

itineraryItems.title: Emerald Bay State Park
itineraryItems.description: Cruise along Emerald Bay with close views of alpine shoreline and Vikingsholm Castle.

itineraryItems.title: Zephyr Cove
itineraryItems.description: Return along the South Shore with views of Zephyr Cove.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Lake Tahoe Emerald Bay Scenic Cruise?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 to 3 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at Lake Tahoe?
faqs.answer: Meet at Zephyr Cove Marina, 760 US-50, Zephyr Cove, NV 89448. Arrive 30 minutes before departure to check in at the boat dock.
